A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same work, Financial Risk Relation Identification through Dual-view Adaptation. All 11 pages in each version, including equations, tables, figures, references, and Appendix A, support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original stock-return correlation experiments, encoder ablations, stock-prediction and retrieval results, a case study, and appendix threshold-sensitivity results.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results in Tables 1–4, Section 5, and Appendix A.

M1.justification: Section 3 retains the same encoder, chronological and lexical positive-pair construction, in-batch negatives, contrastive objective, and threshold-based risk relation scoring procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same Form 10-K and stock-price data covering 337 companies, stock-movement prediction task, MultiHiertt retrieval benchmark, and ENPH–META case study.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged: BERT-base-uncased, Llama-3.2-3B, Contriever, DPR, FinBERT, and SEC-BERT remain in Tables 1 and 4. GICS sector/industry baselines and the ADGAT comparison are also retained.

E3.justification: Training data construction, preprocessing, model configurations, threshold selection, the 280/70/70 stock-prediction split, and the two-stage MultiHiertt retrieval procedure and metrics are unchanged.

E4.justification: Both versions contain the same chronological-versus-lexical ablation in Section 4.6, ENPH–META case study in Section 5, and threshold-sensitivity analysis in Appendix A and Figure 3.

E5.justification: Section 4.7.1 retains 15 runs with different seeds, reporting the top five results, and the Mann–Whitney U test. Table 3 retains the same mean-and-standard-deviation reporting.

E6.justification: All entries in Tables 1–4, the Figure 3 sensitivity curve, and qualitative findings are unchanged. For example, Table 3 reports ADGAT AUCs of 0.5807 ± 0.012 without the proposed relations and 0.5939 ± 0.006 with them in both versions.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, encoder similarity equation, contrastive objective, negative-set formulation, mutual risk paragraph sets, and RRS definition and properties are unchanged. No proofs are added or removed.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about dual-view adaptation, interpretable symmetric risk scoring, and empirical effectiveness. The added code-access statement does not alter the scientific contributions.

C2.justification: Result interpretations and mechanism explanations are unchanged. Section 7 retains the same limitations concerning other relationship types, annual filing frequency, and the absence of expert financial judgment.

D1.justification: v2 adds a code-availability sentence and a GitHub link to cnclabs/codes.fin.relation in the abstract; v1 supplies no such link. Implementation, hyperparameter, hardware, and data-access details otherwise remain unchanged.

R1.justification: The cited works, related-work discussion, and positioning relative to the earlier SURF system demonstration are unchanged.

P1.justification: The abstract gains one code-availability sentence, and the arXiv version/date stamp changes. The remaining prose, terminology, section order, and appendix structure are unchanged.

P2.justification: The added abstract sentence shifts column and page breaks through the early pages. v2 also removes printed page numbers and slightly narrows Table 1. Figures, table structures, captions, and appendix presentation otherwise remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: The new abstract link provides a concrete route to the implementation, modestly improving code discoverability and reproducibility information. Scientific content and supporting evidence, including Appendix A, are unchanged. The PDFs alone do not establish the repository's completeness or usability.
